sources.title: Jets get to work signing their 2026 NFL Draft class ahead of rookie minicamp
sources.description: The Jets are conducting their rookie minicamp this weekend. Ahead of the festivities, the team has begun getting its Draft class under contract. First round pick, Kenyon Sadiq, fourth round pick Cade Klubnik, and sixth round pick Anez Cooper have signed their respective rookie deals. Holdouts in the day and age of the rookie wage […]
